changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Add nullable photo and video metadata populated during normal media indexing.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION media_file_audit_trigger_function() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' OR TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN INSERT INTO media_file_audit( audit_version, operation, changed_at, id, file_id, cre_date, exif_gps_location_long, exif_gps_location_lat, exif_gps_location, gps_altitude_meters, exif_gps_date, exif_date_image_taken, camera_make, camera_model, lens_model, width_pixels, height_pixels, aperture_f_number, exposure_time_seconds, iso_speed, focal_length_mm, focal_length_35mm, duration_seconds, frame_rate, video_codec, audio_codec ) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(audit_version), 0) + 1 FROM media_file_audit WHERE id = OLD.id), TG_OP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, OLD.id, OLD.file_id, OLD.cre_date, OLD.exif_gps_location_long, OLD.exif_gps_location_lat, OLD.exif_gps_location, OLD.gps_altitude_meters, OLD.exif_gps_date, OLD.exif_date_image_taken, OLD.camera_make, OLD.camera_model, OLD.lens_model, OLD.width_pixels, OLD.height_pixels, OLD.aperture_f_number, OLD.exposure_time_seconds, OLD.iso_speed, OLD.focal_length_mm, OLD.focal_length_35mm, OLD.duration_seconds, OLD.frame_rate, OLD.video_codec, OLD.audio_codec; ELSIF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN INSERT INTO media_file_audit( audit_version, operation, changed_at, id, file_id, cre_date, exif_gps_location_long, exif_gps_location_lat, exif_gps_location, gps_altitude_meters, exif_gps_date, exif_date_image_taken, camera_make, camera_model, lens_model, width_pixels, height_pixels, aperture_f_number, exposure_time_seconds, iso_speed, focal_length_mm, focal_length_35mm, duration_seconds, frame_rate, video_codec, audio_codec ) VALUES ( 1, TG_OP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NEW.id, NEW.file_id, NEW.cre_date, NEW.exif_gps_location_long, NEW.exif_gps_location_lat, NEW.exif_gps_location, NEW.gps_altitude_meters, NEW.exif_gps_date, NEW.exif_date_image_taken, NEW.camera_make, NEW.camera_model, NEW.lens_model, NEW.width_pixels, NEW.height_pixels, NEW.aperture_f_number, NEW.exposure_time_seconds, NEW.iso_speed, NEW.focal_length_mm, NEW.focal_length_35mm, NEW.duration_seconds, NEW.frame_rate, NEW.video_codec, NEW.audio_codec ); END IF;
IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
